properties.name: The 45 defect records that later repairs had overtaken were checked one by one against the running build: 23 were already fixed and are now closed on the record
properties.rationale: The gap source that produced this list exists because a defect fixed but never closed on the record was re-fixed wrongly a day later. This pass is the first application of it at scale, and the ratio is the finding: half the open defect records were describing behaviour the build no longer had. That is the cost of a record nobody retires — every one of the 23 was a live-looking to-do that a session could have spent time re-solving, and one of them already was. The 22 that stayed open matter as much: the detector fires on ANY later repair touching the same area, so a clean half of its findings are correct-but-unrelated, which is worth knowing before anyone reads the count as a work queue.
properties.subject: record
properties.summary:
Anthony ruled on 2026-09-07 that the untriaged overtaken-defect gaps get a first pass, with only the unsettleable ones brought back to him. All 45 were settled; none came back. Each fact's claimed-wrong behaviour was tested against the code as it stands at v0.51.0, not against whether something nearby had changed. RESULT: 23 FIXED (closed here by an INVALIDATES edge from this event), 22 STILL OPEN (left open, deliberately, because the later repairs that triggered the gap were unrelated to the defect). A 46th line in the sweep was a gap rather than a fact — adopt never mentioning nesting — and it is fixed too, by chg:adopt-recovers-the-hierarchy-it-was-never-told-to-look-for.

RESIDUE ON FOUR OF THE 23, recorded so a later reader does not treat "fixed" as "nothing left": create_node's replace-versus-merge wording is corrected on every agent-facing surface but ver:constructors-preserve and the upsert test still say replaces, which stays true of the Rust method; the ChangeEvent type enum gained defect_fix but still has no value meaning "an open question was settled"; the refutation detector skips withdrawn endpoints but does not band them as a separate category; and the import-defaults instance is fixed at its root while the general mechanism that produced it, schema defaults injected at write, is one of the 22 still open.

WHAT THIS PASS DOES NOT ESTABLISH: it read code and records, not behaviour. Nothing was executed to confirm a fix, so a defect closed here is closed on the evidence of the source that answers it, named in each case by file and line during the pass.
